problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a series of shipments onto identical cargo aircraft. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 60 metric tons
* Shipment Beta: mass 50 metric tons
* Shipment Gamma: mass 36 metric tons
* Shipment Delta: mass 58 metric tons
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 53 metric tons
* Shipment Zeta: mass 67 metric tons
* Shipment Eta: mass 46 metric tons
* Shipment Theta: mass 61 metric tons
* Shipment Iota: mass 44 metric tons
* Shipment Kappa: mass 40 metric tons
* Shipment Lambda: mass 65 metric tons
* Shipment Mu: mass 65 metric tons
* Shipment Nu: mass 34 metric tons
* Shipment Xi: mass 62 metric tons
* Shipment Omicron: mass 40 metric tons
* Shipment Pi: mass 31 metric tons
* Shipment Rho: mass 40 metric tons
* Shipment Sigma: mass 63 metric tons
* Shipment Tau: mass 56 metric tons
* Shipment Upsilon: mass 68 metric tons
* Shipment Phi: mass 43 metric tons

Each aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 100 metric tons. The objective is to assign every shipment to exactly one aircraft, ensuring the combined mass on any aircraft does not surpass its payload limit, while utilizing the smallest possible number of aircraft.
